name: anim_cru_sway
subject: a huge hyper-muscular pink paint crocodile monster with arms stretched out like a cross and a small black witch cat pinned to its chest, its lower body a melted paint puddle
desc: Slow heavy gooey sway loop in depth: the massive upper body leans forward toward the viewer, chest and arms looming bigger, head tilting down with a leering grin, then sways back away, arching back with the chin up, then returns. Thick goo stretches and drips with the motion. The puddle base stays in place.
